reason: Drill into the sheltered band to retrieve its interior; it is the only offered action.
expectation: A core of the band comes free, hopefully still frozen and clean.

effect: The drill produced a sealed core, ready for cold storage.
reaction: That is reassuring, though the extraction itself passed very quickly.
reason: Put the core in the buffered case to keep it frozen for the journey; this is the only gameplay action offered.
expectation: The sealed core will be stored in the refrigerated case and the goal may complete.

effect: The core is in the case and the frozen-return goal is complete.
reaction: The connection to the case built earlier is satisfying, though the outcome gives little detail about the sample.

mostWorthwhile.text: Putting the sealed core in the buffered case connected the earlier preparation to the scientific goal of preserving the band.

leastWorthwhile.text: Drilling ends immediately with a sealed core, with little sense of the extraction or what the sample looks like.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprised me; both results matched what I expected.

arbitrary.text: Neither action lacked a clear purpose, but each was the only gameplay option, so there was little decision to make.

continue.text: I would continue to discover what the preserved band contains, though I hope the next chapter offers more to decide or observe.
